item.title: Hull accountants share tips for filing your self assessment this January
item.description: January is the busiest month of the year for Self Assessment, and for many people in Hull, it’s their first time tackling it. Whether you’ve recently gone self-employed, started freelancing, or picked up extra income, the process can feel confusing at first. item.title: Scale Lane footbridge: next phase of investigations announced ahead of repair programme
item.description: Hull City Council has confirmed the next phase of investigations on Scale Lane footbridge as part of plans to repair its unique swing mechanism.

item.title: Lord Mayor’s Valentine’s event to showcase songs from the decades
item.description: A Valentine’s music night in Hull will raise funds for the Lord Mayor’s charities, with live songs from the 1950s through to the 2000s at the New Walton Club.

item.title: Emergency removal of carved Hull 2017 tree stump in Pearson Park
item.description: The carved Hull 2017 tree sculpture in Pearson Park has been safely removed after deterioration made it unstable, with the artwork remaining in the park to decay naturally as wildlife habitat.

item.title: Council response to Hull missing out on rail electrification
item.description: Hull City Council responds after Hull misses out on rail electrification, calling for clear commitments and fair funding in Northern Powerhouse Rail plans.

item.title: Hull exhibition designer celebrates 16 years after starting business post-redundancy
item.description: A Hull-based exhibition designer who set up her business the day after being made redundant during the financial crisis is celebrating 16 years of national and international success. item.title: Willerby founder’s family enjoy VIP tour of Hull headquarters
item.description: Willerby has welcomed the family of its founder to Hull for a VIP tour of its facilities as the holiday home manufacturer begins a special year marking its 80th anniversary.

item.title: Free event to discover apprenticeship opportunities
item.description: A free Meet the Employer apprenticeship event in Hull will connect attendees with local employers in engineering, construction and business during National Apprenticeship Week.

item.title: Council unanimously backs Lib Dem call for Northern Powerhouse Rail plans for Hull
item.description: Hull City Council has unanimously backed a Liberal Democrat motion urging the UK Government to commit to Northern Powerhouse Rail plans that include Hull.

item.description: Important research is taking place in Hull that’s helping shape the medical devices people around the world rely on every day – and it’s something you can get involved in.
